pages.title: Zero-Point Energy Extractor
pages.text: Even empty space jitters. This machine $(thing)generates power$() from vacuum fluctuations, burning Casimir plates and exotic matter as catalysts.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 1$() machine.

Honest note: textbook physics says the vacuum's ground state cannot be mined - there is nothing lower to fall to. But the Casimir effect is real: plates set close together feel a measurable push. The $(item)Zero-Point Energy Extractor$() leans on that, with Casimir plates and exotic matter as catalysts. And it does generate power.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.
$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (1 item and 0 fluid inputs, 0 and 0 outputs).
